title: PixelKin - The Ashfall Shelf
_note: The Ashfall Shelf (walkthrough/10 Part II): daylight after three caves - a high grey shelf where Cinderhead's slag was tipped for a century, ash-grass, the haulers' brazier, the wind off Galehigh. snes register (CLAUDE.md area-music rule): pulse25 lead + tri_bass tread kept chip-true, then the band opens - strings dyads, pluck harp arp, sparse bell glints at phrase ends, a flute counter answering in B. D dorian (the B natural is the open sky). Vesper motif: A3->D4->E4 lift, F4->E4->D4 settle, restated an octave up in A'. Stone signature = dry tom taps on beat 3; Storm = a crash 'gust' opening each 8-bar phrase. 24 bars at 104 BPM = ~55 s; bar 24's A major leads back into bar 1. Original (VISION.md).
